slides.title: Win the 27 days before GTA VI
slides.subtitle: Modern Warfare 4 launches Oct 23 at $70, with no Game Pass on day one. App Science® finds the Battlefield, Switch 2 and lapsed Call of Duty homes that now have to be sold, not unlocked, and reaches them on the TV they'll play on.

stat.label: From MW4 launch to GTA VI
stat.body: Pre-orders unlock the campaign Oct 16. MW4 launches Oct 23. GTA VI lands Nov 19. Every player Activision wants has to be won before then. [3, 6]

slides.title: What's happening at Activision right now
slides.kicker: Four signals from the last nine months · Numbered sources on page 15

items.head: Battlefield outsold Call of Duty in the US for the first time
items.body: Circana ranked Black Ops 7 fifth for 2025. Battlefield 6 was number one, after the biggest launch in its history. [1, 2]
items.means: The conquest pool has a name: Battlefield players. They're on their phones every day.

items.head: MW4 at $70, and no Game Pass on day one
items.body: It's the first mainline Call of Duty since the Microsoft deal to skip Game Pass at launch. Pre-orders unlock the campaign Oct 16. [3, 4]
items.means: Lapsed Game Pass players now have to buy. That's a persuasion job, and a household one.

items.head: Call of Duty returns to Nintendo after 13 years
items.body: MW4 is the series' first Nintendo release since 2013. It's a code-in-box launch on Switch 2, after an open beta there in August. [5]
items.means: A brand-new buyer who has never owned Call of Duty. Sabio already builds Switch 2 player audiences.

items.head: GTA VI launches into an otherwise empty November
items.body: Activision moved MW4 into October to stay out of its way. It's the only major release in the month. [6]
items.means: The window to win players, and keep them playing, closes in 27 days.

slides.title: The opening: conquest and win-back
slides.kicker: Why MW4's media should chase the swing households, not the loyal ones
slides.statLabel: Where Black Ops 7 finished in US 2025 sales. Battlefield 6 was number one.
slides.statSource: Sources 1, 2 (Circana via VGC and Game World Observer)
slides.headline: We think MW4 is won on conquest and win-back, not on the core.

points.head: The core is locked
points.body: Franchise players will show up on Oct 16. Budget spent re-reaching them is budget not spent on the homes that decide the launch.

points.head: The swing is named
points.body: Battlefield players, lapsed Black Ops 7 and Game Pass homes, and new Switch 2 owners. Each is an app ecosystem we can see on the phone.

points.head: The clock is short
points.body: Pre-order push to Oct 16, launch on Oct 23, hold players to Nov 19. Three flights, one audience plan.

slides.kicker: Built on our own data, tech and content since 2014

slides.title: Three audiences for the launch window
slides.kicker: Each one is an app ecosystem, not a demographic · Sized on the final build
slides.source: Current Call of Duty players can be suppressed to protect budget, or retargeted for Oct 16 early access. Reach is illustrative until the build is run. App lists finalized with Activision.

cards.name: The Battlefield player
cards.desc: Plays a shooter every week, just not Call of Duty. Plays on console or PC, and it shows on the phone.
cards.apps: EA app · Delta Force · Fortnite · PUBG Mobile · Discord
cards.goal: Switch them to MW4 before Nov 19

cards.name: The lapsed Call of Duty home
cards.desc: Xbox or Game Pass on the phone, and no Call of Duty app opened in 60+ days.
cards.apps: Xbox · Game Pass · PlayStation App · Call of Duty: Mobile
cards.goal: Pre-order, now that Game Pass won't carry it

cards.name: The Switch 2 household
cards.desc: Nintendo apps in use and a Switch 2 in the home. Hasn't had Call of Duty on Nintendo since 2013.
cards.apps: Nintendo Switch App · Nintendo Store · Nintendo Today! · Mario Kart Tour
cards.goal: Buy the code-in-box on day one

slides.title: Three flights, one audience plan
slides.kicker: The TV builds the hype, the phone closes it · Oct 5 to Nov 19
slides.benchmark: Benchmarks: CTV video with QR code, 96% VCR. Mobile video, 85% VCR.

steps.head: Early access is the hook
steps.body: Battlefield and lapsed homes see the MW4 trailer on CTV. The QR code goes to pre-order, and the Oct 16 campaign early access does the selling.

steps.head: Day one on every screen
steps.body: Mobile retargets exposed homes. Switch 2 households get the code-in-box message. Creator TV® spots add reach at launch.

steps.head: Keep them before GTA VI
steps.body: Converted homes are suppressed. Budget shifts to the audiences still converting, until GTA VI takes the spotlight.

paths.head: CTV · view-through to pre-order
steps: Ad plays on the TV. Household IP is logged
Someone in the home scans the QR or searches the store
The pre-order page is visited and the Sabio pixel fires
Visit matched to the impression and read against a 10% holdout

paths.head: Mobile · click-through to install
steps: Ad plays on the phone and is tapped. Device ID logged
Call of Duty app installs and opens
The MMP matches the device ID to the click. Install counted

slides.side:
There are 16 days until early access and 23 until launch.

The audiences take 48 hours to build. We think a Battlefield conquest read is the fastest way to show what the graph adds before GTA VI changes the conversation.

slides.title: Privacy and data considerations
slides.kicker: What we see, what we don't, and what stays put
slides.source: Source: Sabio Internal FAQ and CTV FAQ, 2026. Data management documentation available on request.

cells.head: What we observe
cells.body: Which apps are installed and how recently they're used. Never in-game activity or anything a player types.

cells.head: Age
cells.body: Adults 18+ only. M-rated creative runs only on age-appropriate inventory, with block and allow lists.

cells.head: What leaves Sabio
cells.body: No device IDs. Reporting is aggregated by age, demo and geo. Exposure files can go to your MMP.

cells.head: iOS signal
cells.body: Apple's restrictions mean most app data comes from Android. We show the iOS share on each build.

cells.head: Activision 1P
cells.body: Player lists can be layered in or suppressed through LiveRamp or a clean room, on Activision's terms.

cells.head: Brand safety
cells.body: DoubleVerify on all supply, TAG registered, US only.
